description: Named API-format workflows exposed by the project workflow API.

workflows.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Q4_K_M Text to Image
workflows.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Q4_K_M GGUF transformer, 1024 square, 25 Euler/simple steps and CFG 1.

text.format: Natural-language scene description; quote desired text literally.

resource_limits.basis: RTX 4090 pixel budget with CPU VAE and RAM offload; runtime fit must be measured.

agent_hints.sampling: Official ComfyUI template defaults: 25 steps, Euler/simple, CFG 1, denoise 1.

compatibility_notes: Uses the uncensored Qwen-Image-2.1 Q4_K_M GGUF transformer with the Qwen3VL INT8 encoder and BF16 VAE; incompatible with older Qwen-Image/2511 LoRAs.
Shares the existing named-job coordinator and worker model-unload boundary.

The route applies the publisher's qwen-image-2.1-uncensored-lora (rank 16, attention only, model-only) on top of the UC GGUF at strength 1.0; callers can set loras.uncensored from -2 to 2, or 0 to disable it.

validation.scope: RTX 4090 named API; Q4_K_M 1024x1024 25-step T2I and NSFW Qwen route selection.

probes.scope: uncensored LoRA 1.0 vs 0.0 at the same seed: mean absolute pixel difference 1.05/255, 2.1% of pixels changed by more than 10. All LoRA keys loaded.

12 shared prompts vs moss-image-sft-t2i plus one layout-JSON prompt, all 25 jobs succeeded. MOSS won UI mock-up, long 12-detail scene and layout JSON; Qwen won short prompt, real-place landscape, Chinese poster (MOSS invented a garbled subtitle) and 2 MP macro realism; portrait, product label, menu text, composition, anime and natural-language layout tied. Mean 1 MP time: MOSS 50.0 s, Qwen 47.5 s; 1456 square: MOSS 109.8 s, Qwen 87.3 s.

best_for: general-purpose SFW and NSFW images of real-world subjects: photos, products, food, landscapes, architecture
short or terse prompts (it stays anatomically clean where MOSS-Image does not)
recognisable real places and regional detail
posters and legible text inside the image, including Chinese calligraphy, without invented extra text
not_for: requests for a specific anime model look (JANKU, Anima, One Obsession)

prefer_instead.when: the requester supplies an image and wants it changed by instruction
the requester needs exact placement or sizes of text and objects (layout JSON) or a UI/app mock-up

workflows.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Q4_K_M Image Edit
workflows.description: Uncensored Q4_K_M reference-conditioned editing, using one uploaded image and an instruction. Output follows the source size rounded to multiples of 32.

image.processing: Official TextEncodeQwenImage21 with resolution=0; reference conditioning plus source-sized empty latent. One reference exposed by this named route.
image.use_for: Instruction-based edit of an uploaded photo or illustration: the prompt says what to change (colour, object, material, background, text) and the rest of the image is kept. Not a style transfer and not a face-identity reference.

resource_limits.basis: RTX 4090 pixel budget with CPU VAE and RAM offload; runtime fit must be measured.

agent_hints.sampling: Official ComfyUI template defaults: 25 steps, Euler/simple, CFG 1, denoise 1.
agent_hints.input_image: Required relative uploaded filename. Reference size determines output size, rounded to multiples of 32; batch is one.
agent_hints.prompt_scope: Write the edit as a direct instruction, e.g. 'Change the teapot to cobalt blue. Keep everything else the same.' Name what must stay unchanged when it matters.

compatibility_notes: Uses the uncensored Qwen-Image-2.1 Q4_K_M GGUF transformer with the Qwen3VL INT8 encoder and BF16 VAE; incompatible with older Qwen-Image/2511 LoRAs.
Shares the existing named-job coordinator and worker model-unload boundary.
The official editable-size switch is fixed to false, and reference resolution is 0 as in the template. The named route currently exposes one reference.

The route applies the publisher's qwen-image-2.1-uncensored-lora (rank 16, attention only, model-only) on top of the UC GGUF at strength 1.0; callers can set loras.uncensored from -2 to 2, or 0 to disable it.

validation.scope: RTX 4090 named API; Q4_K_M reference edit using the T2I result at 1024x1024.

probes.scope: Red-to-cobalt teapot edit preserved composition; LoRA 1.0 vs 0.0 mean absolute pixel difference 0.17/255.

best_for: instruction-based edits of an uploaded image that keep everything else (colour, object, material, background or text changes)
photos, renders and illustrations alike
adding or replacing legible text in an existing image
not_for: redrawing an image in an anime model style (use a latent image-to-image route such as anima-turbo-v1-1 or janku-illustrious)
putting the same character into a new scene (use a face-reference route)
repainting only a masked region (use anima-turbo-inpaint or moody-anima-inpaint)

prefer_instead.when: the requester wants the same face or character in a new scene rather than an edit of this image
the requester supplies a mask or wants only one region repainted

workflows.name: MOSS-Image-SFT Text and Layout to Image
workflows.description: OpenMOSS MOSS-Image-SFT 5B DiT with its Qwen3.5 9B encoder, 1024 square, 50 Euler/sgm_uniform steps, CFG 3, shift 5 and negative-branch layer skip at 22.

text.format: A detailed natural-language description, a tag sequence, or a layout JSON object serialised into the prompt string. Quote desired text literally; use line breaks to control text lines. Avoid one- or two-word prompts.

resource_limits.basis: Publisher recommends 1M-2M pixels; RTX 4090 fit with ComfyUI offload must be measured.

agent_hints.sampling: Publisher defaults: 50 Euler steps, CFG 3, shift 5, negative-branch skip-layer guidance at layer 22. Fewer steps degrade quality; short prompts may need a higher CFG.
agent_hints.negative_prompt: Active at CFG 3. Empty by default; the publisher suggests 'worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact'.
agent_hints.size: Width and height should be multiples of 16; other values are floored to 16 by the latent node.
agent_hints.layout: For exact placement, pass a JSON object as the prompt string: {"summary": {"caption": ...}, "items": [{"label", "caption", "text"?, "bbox": [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max]}], "bbox_format": "yxyx", "bbox_coord_space": "abs_centralized"}. Coordinates are integer pixels with the canvas centre as origin (x right, y down), so a 1024 square spans -512..512 on both axes.
agent_hints.prompt_length: Write at least one full descriptive sentence (subject, setting, lighting, style). Terse prompts underperform at CFG 3; the publisher notes they may need a higher CFG.

prompting.language: English has the most training data; Chinese is supported, including rendered Chinese text.

compatibility_notes: Loaded by the MOSS-Image node pack (OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image comfyui/moss-image, pinned in setup_comfyui.ps1) straight from the Hugging Face component directory; native ComfyUI sampling and skip-layer guidance.
ComfyUI runs the Qwen3.5 encoder in FP16 on this deployment; the probe showed no overflow artefacts.
The native sgm_uniform schedule does not snap to the training grid like the publisher's diffusers pipeline, so seeds do not reproduce diffusers images exactly.
Each step runs two transformer passes (CFG 3), so a step costs about twice a CFG-1 route.
Shares the existing named-job coordinator and worker model-unload boundary.
NSFW behaviour is unverified and not advertised.

validation.scope: RTX 4090 named API; 1024x1024 50-step T2I with a plain bilingual-text prompt and a layout JSON prompt; layout boxes landed within about 10 px of the requested coordinates and both English and Chinese text rendered correctly; hot switch to Anima Turbo afterwards succeeded.

probes.scope: Includes cold load of the transformer and text encoder; minimum sampled free VRAM 1.6 GiB.
Four-item yxyx abs_centralized layout (title, bicycle, plant, Chinese caption); minimum sampled free VRAM 2.0 GiB.

12 shared prompts vs qwen-image-2.1-t2i plus one layout-JSON prompt, all 25 jobs succeeded. MOSS won UI mock-up, long 12-detail scene and layout JSON; Qwen won short prompt, real-place landscape, Chinese poster (MOSS invented a garbled subtitle) and 2 MP macro realism; portrait, product label, menu text, composition, anime and natural-language layout tied. Mean 1 MP time: MOSS 50.0 s, Qwen 47.5 s; 1456 square: MOSS 109.8 s, Qwen 87.3 s.

best_for: exact placement and size of text and objects from a layout JSON (posters, covers, slides)
UI and app screen mock-ups with correct labels
long, densely specified scenes where every listed detail must appear
not_for: short prompts: a bare subject such as 'a cat' can produce deformed anatomy; use qwen-image-2.1-t2i or expand the prompt
everyday anime (the anime routes are 5-10x faster and NSFW-capable)

prefer_instead.when: a general photo, product, landscape or poster request with no layout or UI requirement, or a short prompt

workflows.name: Moody Anima Mix — General Anime Fallback
workflows.description: Fast Anima-based anime workflow for generic illustrations and portraits. It is the default anime fallback when the request does not require a DeepSeek whale girl, NIKKE or other model-specific identity/style route.

exclusion_rules: Do not choose this route when the request explicitly requires a DeepSeek whale girl or NIKKE model-specific style or identity route; those specialized routes outrank this fallback.

capabilities.character_identity: weak; no character-specific adapter is bundled

text.format: short natural-language visual description or a light anime tag description

upload.response_to_parameter: Join returned subfolder and name with '/' and pass the result as input_image.

image.processing: LoadImage -> ImageScale -> VAEEncode -> RepeatLatentBatch -> sampler. Explicit width/height set output size (stretch); one dimension preserves aspect ratio; omitted dimensions use source size rounded down to multiples of 8. batch_size is honored.
image.use_for: Restyle or vary the source in this route's model style. Composition and colours carry over; character identity is not guaranteed. Lower denoise keeps more of the source. For instruction edits use qwen-image-2.1-edit; for the same face in a new scene use a face-reference route; to repaint one region use an inpaint route.

probes.scope: API validation, installed-model execution and output delivery; not a visual-fidelity benchmark

generic anime portrait

agent_hints.negative_prompt: Accepted as a parameter, but ineffective at the default CFG 1. Guidance above 1 activates negative conditioning and changes distilled-model behavior.

assuming the base checkpoint alone guarantees a named character likeness

workflows.name: Moody Anima Mix — Masked Inpaint
workflows.description: Core-node latent inpaint route for changing only the masked region while preserving the rest of an Anima reference image.

exclusion_rules: Use a real mask for the region to redraw; do not use this route for whole-image style transfer or pose control.

capabilities.character_identity: weak; no character-specific adapter is bundled
capabilities.outfit_control: high inside the mask, low outside the mask
capabilities.pixel_preservation: Original pixels outside the supplied mask are restored after VAE decode.

text.format: Short description of the replacement content; start with 1girl, solo when the source is a character sheet or multi-view reference.

image.processing: Source dimensions (multiples of 8) determine output size. The source is VAE-encoded and the grown mask is set as a latent noise mask, so only the masked region is resampled; the result is composited onto the original image using the supplied mask so pixels outside it remain unchanged.

upload.response_to_parameter: Join returned subfolder and name with '/' and pass the result as input_image.

image.use_for: Repaint only the masked region. denoise 1.0 (default) replaces the region with what the prompt describes; 0.5-0.8 keeps the original structure inside the mask and only alters it.

mask.format: RGB: white/red pixels are redrawn, black pixels preserved. Alpha: transparent pixels are redrawn, opaque pixels preserved (ComfyUI inverse alpha). Mask and source must have identical dimensions.

upload.response_to_parameter: Join returned subfolder and name with '/' and pass the result as parameters.mask_image.

mask.processing: LoadImageMask selects the configured channel; VAEEncodeForInpaint combines the source and mask and KSampler applies noise only to the masked region

probes.scope: API validation, installed-model execution and output delivery; not a visual-fidelity benchmark

limitations: A SFW probe validates graph execution and mask plumbing, not clothing fidelity or prompt adherence.

best_for: local clothing replacement
local accessory replacement
masked repair
preserving an unmasked character and background
not_for: whole-image generation without a source and mask

agent_hints.prompt_scope: Describe only the desired replacement in the masked region plus a short preservation cue. Keep the prompt short; explicitly add 1girl, solo when a reference sheet could induce multiple views.
agent_hints.mask_image: The mask is executable, not a semantic region label. White/red means redraw and black means preserve; use mask_channel to select the channel.
agent_hints.denoise: 1.0 replaces the masked region; lower values keep more of the original inside the mask. Draw the mask a little larger than the object; the hard composite edge follows the mask.
agent_hints.negative_prompt: Accepted as a parameter, but ineffective at the default CFG 1. Guidance above 1 activates negative conditioning and changes distilled-model behavior.
avoid: sending a character sheet without 1girl, solo
expecting denoise alone to isolate clothing
using an unmasked source when only a local edit is wanted
requesting pose control without a ControlNet route

compatibility_notes: This route uses ComfyUI's core VAEEncodeForInpaint node and KSampler noise_mask; no separate inpaint checkpoint is required.
The route deliberately requires a source image and a mask so the API cannot silently fall back to full-image denoise.
The workflow is a minimal API graph and does not expose a segmentation model; callers provide the mask image.
This is a generic noise-mask workflow using a base checkpoint, not a model trained specifically for inpainting. Masked-region coherence depends on prompt and denoise.

prompting.style: short natural-language replacement instruction with optional light anime tags

granularity.selection_hint: Use minimal for clothing changes; add structured details only for material, color, fit or lighting constraints.
granularity.enforcement: advisory; known levels are accepted even outside the recommended range

examples.prompt: 1girl, solo, a navy school uniform with a neat red ribbon, preserve the face, hair, pose and background

notes: CFG 1 skips negative conditioning. Negative text has no effect at the default setting; CFG changes can affect distilled-model quality.

exclusion_rules: Use a real mask for the region to redraw; do not use this route for whole-image style transfer or pose control.

image.processing: Source dimensions (multiples of 8) determine output size. mask.format: RGB: white/red pixels are redrawn, black pixels preserved. Alpha: transparent pixels are redrawn, opaque pixels preserved (ComfyUI inverse alpha). Mask and source must have identical dimensions.

upload.response_to_parameter: Join returned subfolder and name with '/' and pass the result as parameters.mask_image.

workflows.description: Pinned One Obsession v24 single-file SDXL/Illustrious workflow for high-detail anime with rich texture, dramatic light/shadow and polished 2D-to-2.5D rendering.

exclusion_rules: Do not use this generic route for explicit DeepSeek whale girl, NIKKE, face-reference, OpenPose or inpaint requirements; those capability-specific routes take precedence.

capabilities.character_identity: strong stylized character illustration from tags without a required trigger word
capabilities.style_control: strong for rich texture, dramatic light/shadow and polished 2D/2.5D rendering

upload.response_to_parameter: Join returned subfolder and name with '/' and pass the result as input_image.

image.processing: LoadImage -> ImageScale -> VAEEncode -> RepeatLatentBatch -> sampler. Explicit width/height set output size; one dimension preserves aspect ratio; omitted dimensions use source size rounded down to multiples of 8. batch_size is honored.
image.use_for: Restyle or vary the source in this route's model style. Composition and colours carry over; character identity is not guaranteed. Lower denoise keeps more of the source. For instruction edits use qwen-image-2.1-edit; for the same face in a new scene use a face-reference route; to repaint one region use an inpaint route.

probes.scope: One Obsession v24 named API run; compared visually with v20_BOLD at the same seed. Not an NSFW benchmark.

limitations: The SFW probe validates graph execution and checkpoint loading, not visual quality, character likeness, NSFW quality or prompt fidelity.
